scripts.start: docker compose up -d controller-prod --build && docker logs home-automation-controller-prod --follow
scripts.restart: docker compose down controller-prod && docker compose up controller-prod -d --build && docker logs home-automation-controller-prod --follow
scripts.local:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml --env-file local-dev/.env.local --profile local --profile dev up --build
scripts.local:up:prod: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml --env-file local-dev/.env.local --profile local --profile prod up --build
scripts.local:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml --env-file local-dev/.env.local --profile local --profile dev --profile prod down -v
